**Write it as.** `Preventive controls prevent actions from occurring` · `Detective controls detect specific events when they occur` · `before the resources are provisioned`

**Scope.** AWS Control Tower controls.

> "Preventive controls prevent actions from occurring."
> — [How controls work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-controls-work.html)

> "Detective controls detect specific events when they occur and log the action in CloudTrail."
> — [How controls work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-controls-work.html)

> "Proactive controls check whether resources are compliant with your company policies and objectives, before the resources are provisioned in your accounts. If the resources are out of compliance, they are not provisioned."
> — [How controls work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-controls-work.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.

### control-tower-preventive-not-on-management-account

**Claim.** Control Tower preventive controls are not applied to the management account; the root user and administrators in the management account can perform work that controls would otherwise deny, and their actions are still logged in the log archive account.

**Write it as.** `not applied to the management account` · `This exception is intentional` · `continue to be tracked in the logs`

**Scope.** Control Tower management account.

> "Preventive controls are not applied to the management account."
> — [How AWS Control Tower works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-control-tower-works.html)

> "The root user and any administrators in the management account can perform work that controls would otherwise deny. This exception is intentional. It prevents the management account from entering into an unusable state. All actions taken within the management account continue to be tracked in the logs contained within the log archive account, for purposes of accountability and auditing."
> — [About controls in AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/controls.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.

### control-tower-preventive-status-all-regions

**Claim.** A preventive control disallows actions that lead to policy violations; its status is enforced or not enabled, and preventive controls are supported in all AWS Regions.

**Write it as.** `it disallows actions that lead to policy violations` · `Preventive controls are supported in all AWS Regions`

**Scope.** Control Tower preventive controls.

> "A preventive control ensures that your accounts maintain compliance, because it disallows actions that lead to policy violations. The status of a preventive control is either enforced or not enabled. Preventive controls are supported in all AWS Regions."
> — [Preventive controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/preventive-controls.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.

### control-tower-proactive-only-cloudformation

**Claim.** Proactive controls check resources when they are created or updated through CloudFormation stack operations, so they may not affect requests made directly through the console, APIs, SDKs or other infrastructure-as-code tools.

**Write it as.** `by means of CloudFormation stack operations` · `may not affect requests that are made directly`

**Scope.** Control Tower proactive controls.

> "Proactive controls check resources whenever those resources are created or updated by means of CloudFormation stack operations."
> — [Proactive controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/proactive-controls.html)

> "As a consequence, these controls may not affect requests that are made directly to services through the AWS console, through AWS APIs, or through other means such as AWS SDKs, or other Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools."
> — [Proactive controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/proactive-controls.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.

### control-tower-proactive-status-pass-fail-skip

**Claim.** A proactive control scans resources before provisioning; noncompliant resources are not provisioned, and the control status is PASS, FAIL or SKIP.

**Write it as.** `scans your resources before they are provisioned` · `PASS, FAIL, or SKIP`

**Scope.** Control Tower proactive controls.

> "Proactive – A proactive control scans your resources before they are provisioned, and makes sure that the resources are compliant with that control. Resources that are not compliant will not be provisioned."
> — [Control behavior and guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/control-behavior.html)

> "The status of a proactive control is PASS, FAIL, or SKIP."
> — [Control behavior and guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/control-behavior.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.

### control-tower-recommended-additional-ous

**Claim.** Beyond the Security OU, the Control Tower guidance recommends a Sandbox OU, an Infrastructure OU for shared services and networking accounts, and a Workloads OU for production workloads.

**Write it as.** `called the Sandbox OU` · `the Infrastructure OU` · `called the Workloads OU`

**Scope.** AWS multi-account strategy for a Control Tower landing zone.

> "We recommend that you allow AWS Control Tower to create at least one additional OU, called the Sandbox OU."
> — [AWS multi-account strategy for your AWS Control Tower landing zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/aws-multi-account-landing-zone.html)

> "Two recommended other OUs you can set up on your own: the Infrastructure OU, to contain your shared services and networking accounts, and an OU to contain your production workloads, called the Workloads OU."
> — [AWS multi-account strategy for your AWS Control Tower landing zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/aws-multi-account-landing-zone.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.

### control-tower-region-deny-blocks-unlisted-regions

**Claim.** The Region deny control disallows unlisted operations in global and Regional services outside the specified Regions, including Regions where Control Tower is not available and Regions not selected for governance; actions are allowed as usual in governed Regions.

**Write it as.** `disallows access to unlisted operations` · `outside of the specified Regions` · `allowed as usual in Regions with Governed status`

**Scope.** Control Tower Region deny control.

> "This control disallows access to unlisted operations in global and regional services outside of the specified Regions. That includes all Regions where AWS Control Tower is not available, as well as all Regions not selected for governance in the Landing zone settings page. Actions are allowed as usual in Regions with Governed status."
> — [Deny access to AWS based on the requested AWS Region](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/primary-region-deny-policy.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-12.
